decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanCW-0335-005 00CW-0335-006 00CW-0335-100 01CW-0335-110 01CW-0335-200 01CW-0335-210 01Planning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The glazing serving the side elevation of the development indicated on drawing CW-0335-210 01 shall be non opening below 1.7m of the finished floor level and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.
description: Rear and side dormers with PV photo-voltaic panel, front roof lights and external wall insulation to first floor.
